events.subtitle: A piano recital from Handel and Schubert to rare Dominican and Brazilian repertory
events.factual_description: Washington Performing Arts presents pianist Daniil Trifonov at the Music Center at Strathmore in North Bethesda on Thursday December 10, 2026 at 7:30 p.m. The published recital opens with Handel's Suite in E Major, Stravinsky's Piano Sonata and Schubert's Wanderer Fantasie, then turns to Latin American works by Juan Francisco García, Heitor Villa-Lobos, Rafael Bullumba Landestoy, Alberto Ginastera and Mozart Camargo Guarnieri, as well as Trifonov's Tango. Exact ticket price and live inventory are not established here.

en.why_it_matters: The surprise is in the second half: after Schubert's Wanderer Fantasie and Stravinsky, Trifonov turns toward Juan Francisco García, Bullumba Landestoy, Villa-Lobos, Ginastera and Guarnieri. Hearing neglected Dominican and Brazilian piano writing from this level of interpreter, in a local hall, gives the recital unusually rich stakes.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for the December recital in North Bethesda. It is the rare local program where a major virtuoso can also expand the listening map beyond the familiar European canon, without requiring travel.
